feature: Find and document UI components missing i18n internationalization
description: Search through the frontend codebase to identify UI components that contain hardcoded text strings instead of using the i18n translation system. This includes React/Vue components with hardcoded English text in JSX/templates, labels, buttons, error messages, tooltips, and other user-facing strings. Document the findings in a structured list organized by component path, showing the hardcoded strings and suggesting translation keys. This task is critical for supporting international users and maintaining consistency across the application.

phases.name: Scan Frontend Codebase for Hardcoded Strings

subtasks.description: Scan all *.tsx and *.jsx files in apps/frontend/src/renderer/ to identify hardcoded text strings in JSX elements
Identify and catalog user-facing hardcoded strings (buttons, labels, placeholders, error messages, tooltips, dialog titles, menu items, aria-labels)
Review existing translation keys in apps/frontend/src/shared/i18n/locales/en/*.json and fr/*.json
subtasks.notes: Analyzed all 12 English translation files. Documented 2,500+ keys, naming conventions, and patterns. Created translation_files_analysis.md with comprehensive guidelines.

subtasks.description: Match hardcoded strings to existing translation keys where possible to avoid duplicates
subtasks.notes: Cross-referenced 200+ hardcoded strings with 2,500+ existing keys. Identified 80 strings (40%) that can reuse existing keys and 120 strings (60%) that need new keys. Created SUBTASK-2-2-KEY-MATCHING-REPORT.md with comprehensive matching strategy and implementation phases.

subtasks.description: Document each hardcoded string with exact component file path and line number
subtasks.notes: Created SUBTASK-3-1-HARDCODED-STRINGS-WITH-EXACT-LINES.md with comprehensive documentation. Covered 11 component directories, 38+ component files, 132+ hardcoded strings with exact line numbers. Organized by component path, includes context, suggested keys, severity, and implementation priority.

subtasks.description: Suggest translation keys following existing namespace:section.key pattern (e.g., navigation:items.createSpec)
subtasks.notes: Created SUBTASK-3-2-TRANSLATION-KEYS-SUGGESTIONS.md master reference. Consolidated all 200+ hardcoded strings into 150+ unique keys. Organized into 3 categories: 80+ existing keys to reuse (40%), 70+ keys to add to existing files (35%), 50+ keys in 9 new translation files (25%). Provided JSON snippets for all additions, naming conventions, implementation guidelines, and code examples.

subtasks.description: Organize report by component path and prioritize findings by severity (HIGH: labels/buttons, MEDIUM: tooltips/help text, LOW: aria-labels)
subtasks.notes: Created I18N-INVESTIGATION-REPORT.md final comprehensive report. Organized all 200+ hardcoded strings by component path and severity (HIGH: 150+, MEDIUM: 40+, LOW: 10+). Structured into 7 parts: Executive Summary, HIGH Severity Findings, MEDIUM Severity Findings, LOW Severity Findings, Detailed Findings by Component Path (38+ components), Implementation Plan (3-week schedule), and Recommendations. Includes exact line numbers, suggested translation keys, duplicate prevention strategy, and verification checklist.

issues_fixed.title: Implement missing i18n translation keys
issues_fixed.description: QA feedback requested implementation of missing i18n based on investigation documents. Added 150+ translation keys across 8 new files (ideation, worktrees, credentialProfiles, context, githubIssues, gitlabMR, workspace, changelog) and extended 7 existing files (common, dialogs, errors, tasks, settings, navigation, insights) for both English and French locales.
